articles.title: ZetaChain holders approve plan to wind down L1, move ZETA to Solana
articles.snippet: ZetaChain plans to wind down its Cosmos-based layer 1 and migrate ZETA to Solana, joining other crypto projects moving away from standalone chains.

articles.title: Crypto Worker's Children Held Hostage in Latest French ‘Wrench Attack,’ $46,000 Taken
articles.snippet: France is the worst-hit country in the world for these attacks, with more than 70 logged in the first eight months of 2026.

articles.title: Ethereum Founder Vitalik Buterin Says AI Won’t Doom Crypto Security
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder said AI could help developers mathematically verify entire software systems, turning the same technology powering new attacks into a tool for defense.
